title: ญาติเล่าเหตุสะเทือนขวัญ ประกาศตามหาสาวโคราช ก่อนพบเป็นศพที่ไต้หวัน

desc: รัฐบาลแจง FTA ไทย–EU ยังเจรจาไม่ได้ข้อยุติ UPOV 1991 ย้ำกฎหมายปัจจุบันยังคุ้มครองสิทธิเกษตรกรเก็บเมล็ดพันธุ์ไว้ปลูกต่อ วอนอย่าสรุปล่วงหน้า
title_cn: 泰欧FTA谈判未定论 政府重申继续保护农民留种权
summary_cn: 泰国政府澄清与欧盟FTA谈判尚未就UPOV 1991达成最终协议。政府强调现行法律仍保护农民保留种子进行后续种植的权利，呼吁各界勿妄下结论。该议题涉及农业知识产权与农民权益平衡。

title: โซลาร์จีนทะลัก รับรัฐแจก 5 หมื่น ไทยนำเข้า 7 เดือนทะลุ 1.4 หมื่นล้าน พุ่ง 88.7%
desc: อึ้ง! 7 เดือนแรกปีนี้ ไทยนำเข้าแผงโซลาร์เซลล์ทะลุ 1.4 หมื่นล้านบาท พุ่ง 88.7% จีนครองแชมป์เกือบทั้งหมด รับความต้องการลดค่าไฟ หนุนโซลาร์รูฟท็อปภาคประชาชนตามนโยบายรัฐ
title_cn: 中国太阳能面板进口激增88.7% 泰国7月突破140亿泰铢
summary_cn: 今年前7个月，泰国太阳能电池板进口额激增88.7%，突破140亿泰铢，中国产品占绝对优势。增长动力来自全民降电费需求和政府鼓励私人屋顶太阳能推广政策，推动家庭和企业广泛安装光伏系统。

title: กลุ่มเซ็นทรัล ล็อก 200 ทำเลทองเวียดนาม ขยายสู่เมืองรอง เปิดจริง 50-70 แห่ง 3-5 ปี
desc: “เซ็นทรัล” ทุ่มลงทุนเวียดนามรอบใหม่ 3,500 ล้านดอลลาร์ CRC รับ 1,500 ล้านดอลลาร์ใน 3-5 ปี ลุย 200 ทำเล คัดเหลือ 50-70 แห่ง ขยายเมืองรอง ไม่ลงร้านเล็กถี่ๆ แบบเจ้าถิ่น
title_cn: 中央百货越南扩张计划 35亿美元投资3-5年开业50-70家门店
summary_cn: 泰国中央百货集团(Central)新一轮越南投资额35亿美元，其中CRC获投15亿美元。集团从200个候选地点筛选至50-70家门店，专注二三线城市扩张，避免重复密集开店，预期在3-5年内完成部署。

title: MRT สายสีน้ำเงิน-สายสีม่วง แจ้งเปิดให้บริการตามปกติทุกสถานีแล้ว
desc: รถไฟฟ้า MRT สายสีน้ำเงิน-สายสีม่วง แจ้งเปิดให้บริการตามปกติทุกสถานี หลังเกิดเหตุเพลิงไหม้บริเวณแนวทางรถไฟ
title_cn: MRT 蓝线、紫线全线恢复正常运营
summary_cn: 曼谷地铁MRT蓝线与紫线因铁路沿线火灾事故中断服务，已恢复全线正常运营。这两条线路是曼谷主要公共交通动脉，日均客流量庞大，任何中断都会严重影响市民出行。火灾应急处置已完毕，安全检查通过，乘客可安心乘坐。MRT将持续监控线路状况，确保后续运营安全平稳。
desc_original: รถไฟฟ้า MRT สายสีน้ำเงิน-สายสีม่วง แจ้งเปิดให้บริการตามปกติทุกสถานี หลังเกิดเหตุเพลิงไหม้บริเวณแนวทางรถไฟ

title: NISSAN ย้ำ  ไปต่อ ไม่ต้องรอชาร์จ ปล่อยโฆษณาใหม่ ชูจุดขาย e-POWER
desc: Nissan Thailand เดินหน้าต่อยอดแคมเปญ ทุกนาทีมีค่า ส่งโฆษณาชุดใหม่ ชีวิตไปต่อ ไม่ต้องรอชาร์จ ชวนปรับมุมมองจากการเสียเวลาจอดรอชาร์จไฟ ไปสู่การเพิ่มเวลาใช้ชีวิตอย่างคุ้มค่า
title_cn: 日产(NISSAN)推出新广告宣传e-POWER混动技术
summary_cn: 日产泰国公司推出新一轮广告宣传，主题为「生活继续，无需等待充电」，着重宣传e-POWER混动技术的实用优势。广告旨在改变消费者对电动车充电耗时的认知，强调e-POWER技术能有效减少充电等待时间，让用户获得更多宝贵的生活时间。此举反映日产在泰国市场的战略调整，致力于推广更贴近消费者需求的新能源解决方案。
desc_original: Nissan Thailand เดินหน้าต่อยอดแคมเปญ ทุกนาทีมีค่า ส่งโฆษณาชุดใหม่ ชีวิตไปต่อ ไม่ต้องรอชาร์จ ชวนปรับมุมมองจากการเสียเวลาจอดรอชาร์จไฟ ไปสู่การเพิ่มเวลาใช้ชีวิตอย่างคุ้มค่า

title_cn: 2026年9月21日泰国油价最新报价
summary_cn: 泰国今日油价更新发布，涵盖汽油、汽油-柴油混合燃料、柴油等全类型燃料。报价来自多家主要加油站：泰国石油公司(PTT)、中部石油(Bangchak)、石油公司(PT)、卡尔特克斯(Caltex)、赛斯科(Susco)及壳牌(Shell)等。油价波动直接影响泰国消费品物价与交通成本，与在泰居民和游客的日常生活支出密切相关。

title: Day of reckoning for rival tech schools
desc: Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-Ok's Uthenthawai Campus and the Pathumwan Institute of Technology (PIT), two of Bangkok's oldest technical institutions, were ordered on Sept 9 to suspend on-site teaching for at least three months.
title_cn: 曼谷两所技术学院被下令停止校内教学
summary_cn: 曼谷历史悠久的泰国国家技术大学(Rajamangala University of Technology)Tawan-Ok校Uthenthawai分校与帕通万技术学院(PIT)于9月9日被下令停止校内教学至少三个月。这两所机构是曼谷重要的职业教育基地，教学禁令影响大量学生的学业进程。此项行政处分涉及教学质量、管理规范或安全等问题，反映泰国教育部门的监管更新。
desc_original: Rajamangala University of Technology Tawan-Ok's Uthenthawai Campus and the Pathumwan Institute of Technology (PIT), two of Bangkok's oldest technical institutions, were ordered on Sept 9 to suspend on-site teaching for at least three months.

title: ทีพีซีประกาศลั่น!ปรับทัพธุรกิจครั้งใหญ่  โชว์รายได้ทะยาน 4 พันล้าน
desc: ทีพีซีเล็งคลอดโปรดักต์ใหม่ จ่อชงเรื่องเข้าครม.เปิดทางขายคนไทย ไลฟ์สไตล์พรีเมียม ลดพึ่งพารายได้วีซ่าต่างชาติ มั่นใจปีงบประมาณ 2569 กวาดรายได้ทุบสถิติ 4,000 ล้านบาท
title_cn: TPC宣布大规模业务重组，目标营收40亿泰铢
summary_cn: TPC公司宣布推出新产品，计划向政府内阁提案，以拓展面向泰国消费者的高端生活方式产品线。该公司目标是减少对外国游客签证收入的依赖，实现收入来源多元化。根据计划，在2569财政年度(2026年10月至2027年9月)，TPC有信心实现40亿泰铢的营收目标，创造历史新高，体现其商业模式的重大战略调整。
desc_original: ทีพีซีเล็งคลอดโปรดักต์ใหม่ จ่อชงเรื่องเข้าครม.เปิดทางขายคนไทย ไลฟ์สไตล์พรีเมียม ลดพึ่งพารายได้วีซ่าต่างชาติ มั่นใจปีงบประมาณ 2569 กวาดรายได้ทุบสถิติ 4,000 ล้านบาท

title: กลุ่ม TCP ดันซอฟต์พาวเวอร์ไทย สร้างแพลตฟอร์มบันเทิงเจาะตลาดจีน
desc: กลุ่มธุรกิจ TCP เดินหน้าปั้นแบรนด์ เรดบูล ในจีน ใช้ดนตรี ศิลปะ อาหาร และวัฒนธรรมไทยเชื่อมผู้บริโภค พร้อมดันศิลปินและอุตสาหกรรมสร้างสรรค์ไทย ผ่าน Very Thai Music Festival 2026 ที่หูโจว
title_cn: TCP集团力推泰国软实力 打造娱乐平台开拓中国市场
summary_cn: TCP集团通过音乐、艺术、美食及泰国文化元素，在中国推广Red Bull品牌。该集团将在杭州举办Very Thai Music Festival 2026，进一步推广泰国艺人和创意产业，深化中泰文化交流与商业合作。
desc_original: กลุ่มธุรกิจ TCP เดินหน้าปั้นแบรนด์ เรดบูล ในจีน ใช้ดนตรี ศิลปะ อาหาร และวัฒนธรรมไทยเชื่อมผู้บริโภค พร้อมดันศิลปินและอุตสาหกรรมสร้างสรรค์ไทย ผ่าน Very Thai Music Festival 2026 ที่หูโจว

title: Media explores AI opportunities, risks
desc: The Thai Journalists Association (TJA) and the Lao Journalists Association (LJA) have reaffirmed their partnership, highlighting both the opportunities and risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) in regional reporting.
title_cn: 泰老媒体探讨AI机遇与风险
summary_cn: 泰国记者协会与老挝记者协会重申合作伙伴关系，共同探讨人工智能在地区新闻报道中带来的机遇和风险，推进东南亚媒体协作应对AI时代挑战。
desc_original: The Thai Journalists Association (TJA) and the Lao Journalists Association (LJA) have reaffirmed their partnership, highlighting both the opportunities and risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) in regional reporting.

title: Krungsri event celebrates sustainable transition efforts
desc: Bank of Ayudhya Plc (Krungsri), Thailand's fifth-largest financial group by assets, loans and deposits, and one of the country's six domestic systemically important banks, is turning transition plans into action, strengthening its business network and supporting sustainable growth.
title_cn: 大城银行推进可持续转型 强化业务网络
summary_cn: 泰国资产排名第五的金融集团大城银行（Krungsri），作为六家系统重要银行之一，将可持续发展转型计划付诸实施，加强业务网络建设，支持经济可持续增长。
desc_original: Bank of Ayudhya Plc (Krungsri), Thailand's fifth-largest financial group by assets, loans and deposits, and one of the country's six domestic systemically important banks, is turning transition plans into action, strengthening its business network and supporting sustainable growth.

title: Nurturing Thailand's screen talent
desc: Moving Thailand's film and series industry forward requires comprehensive support and improvements across the spectrum, including education, sufficient development time and funding, according to Nottapon Boonprakob, the renowned Thai film and series director and screenwriter.
title_cn: 培育泰国影视产业人才刻不容缓
summary_cn: 著名泰国电影及剧集导演兼编剧Nottapon Boonprakob指出，推动泰国影视产业发展需在教育、制作周期和融资等多环节提供全面支持，才能培育更多优秀产业人才。
desc_original: Moving Thailand's film and series industry forward requires comprehensive support and improvements across the spectrum, including education, sufficient development time and funding, according to Nottapon Boonprakob, the renowned Thai film and series director and screenwriter.

title: Thai brokerages could crater as new players compete
desc: Thailand's brokerage industry could undergo major consolidation amid intensified competition, with the number of securities firms potentially falling by half to around 15, says Kitipong Urapeepatanapong, chairman of the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
title_cn: 泰国证券经纪业面临剧变 竞争加剧触发行业整合
summary_cn: 泰国证交所主席Kitipong Urapeepatanapong警示，证券经纪业竞争加剧、新玩家涌入，可能引发行业大规模整合，证券公司数量有望从现在的30家左右下降至约15家。
desc_original: Thailand's brokerage industry could undergo major consolidation amid intensified competition, with the number of securities firms potentially falling by half to around 15, says Kitipong Urapeepatanapong, chairman of the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

title: US tariff deal  'taking shape'
desc: Thailand has secured its desired tariff rate it sought from the United States but one additional condition raised by Washington remains to be finalised, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Sunday.
title_cn: 美国关税协议「初步成型」
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷表示，泰国已获得美国同意的理想关税税率，但华盛顿提出的一项额外条件仍需敲定。这项协议涉及两国贸易关系，将影响相关产业的进口成本与竞争力。
desc_original: Thailand has secured its desired tariff rate it sought from the United States but one additional condition raised by Washington remains to be finalised, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Sunday.

title: PM vows no special treatment
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has vowed not to protect anyone suspected of fraud in local government recruitment exams, saying he is awaiting further details before deciding whether further action is needed.
title_cn: 总理誓言不徇私情
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷承诺不会庇护任何在地方政府招聘考试中涉嫌舞弊的人员，表示正在等待更多细节以决定是否采取进一步行动，体现廉政立场。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has vowed not to protect anyone suspected of fraud in local government recruitment exams, saying he is awaiting further details before deciding whether further action is needed.

title: Most 'unfazed' by Senate case: poll
desc: More than half of respondents to a Nida Poll survey are not worried that the Election Commission's decision to prosecute 77 people, including 26 sitting senators, over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election will cause political unrest.
title_cn: 民调：多数民众对参议院案件「不以为然」
summary_cn: 尼达民调显示，超过半数受访者不担心选举委员会起诉77人（其中26名现任参议员）涉嫌2024年参议院选举串通舞弊一案会引发政治动荡，反映出公众对此事件的关注度相对有限。
desc_original: More than half of respondents to a Nida Poll survey are not worried that the Election Commission's decision to prosecute 77 people, including 26 sitting senators, over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election will cause political unrest.

title: Ministry makes headway on driver pay
desc: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry has made progress in developing a framework for calculating a minimum payment rate for drivers in on-demand ride-hailing and parcel delivery services.
title_cn: 数字经济部推进司机薪酬框架
summary_cn: 泰国数字经济和社会部在制定网约车和快递配送司机最低报酬率计算框架方面取得进展，旨在保护从业者权益、规范新兴移动平台的劳资标准。
desc_original: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry has made progress in developing a framework for calculating a minimum payment rate for drivers in on-demand ride-hailing and parcel delivery services.

title: AI growth with guardrails
desc: The growing global debate about whether to slow artificial intelligence (AI) development to address its potential dangers should be a wake-up call for Thailand to step up its cyberdefence and human oversight as the country pursues AI-driven growth.
title_cn: 人工智能增长需设防护栏
summary_cn: 全球对减缓人工智能发展潜在风险的争议日益增多，泰国应以此为警示，在追求 AI 驱动增长的同时加强网络防御和人工监督机制，防范风险。
desc_original: The growing global debate about whether to slow artificial intelligence (AI) development to address its potential dangers should be a wake-up call for Thailand to step up its cyberdefence and human oversight as the country pursues AI-driven growth.

title: FTI advisor urges balanced use of AI
desc: People should make smart and balanced use of artificial intelligence (AI) to avoid becoming overly dependent on the technology and developing a "rusty brain", despite its growing importance in manufacturing and business operations, according to Supant Mongkolsuthree, honorary chairman of the Federation of Thai Industries.
title_cn: 泰国工业联合会顾问呼吁平衡使用人工智能
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会(Federation of Thai Industries)荣誉主席呼吁民众智慧平衡地使用人工智能(AI)，避免过度依赖导致「大脑生锈」。虽然AI在制造业和商业运营中作用日益重要，但盲目依赖可能带来消极影响，需在技术便利和保持独立思考间找到平衡。
desc_original: People should make smart and balanced use of artificial intelligence (AI) to avoid becoming overly dependent on the technology and developing a "rusty brain", despite its growing importance in manufacturing and business operations, according to Supant Mongkolsuthree, honorary chairman of the Federation of Thai Industries.

title: Townsend hit by pitch roller
desc: The Football Association of Thailand has spoken out after Andros Townsend, the 35-year-old former England international forward of PT Prachuap FC, was struck by a pitch roller while warming up with his teammates during half-time in their match against Pattani FC.
title_cn: 英援陶森森赛中被草坪滚筒击伤
summary_cn: 泰超普拉查普足球俱乐部英籍前锋安德鲁斯·陶森森(Andros Townsend)，35岁前英格兰国脚，在对阵帕坦FC(Pattani FC)的比赛中场休息期间热身时被草坪滚筒击中受伤。泰国足协已就此安全事故作出回应，引发对赛场防卫工作的关注。
desc_original: The Football Association of Thailand has spoken out after Andros Townsend, the 35-year-old former England international forward of PT Prachuap FC, was struck by a pitch roller while warming up with his teammates during half-time in their match against Pattani FC.

title: Four suspects sought over deadly Narathiwat attack
desc: Authorities are hunting for four suspected leaders of a group blamed for a disturbance in Narathiwat's Sukhirin district on Friday that left two territorial defence volunteers dead and 16 injured.
title_cn: 陶公府苏基林县暴力事件四嫌犯在逃
summary_cn: 当局正缉捕四名嫌疑人，他们被指为陶公府(Narathiwat)苏基林县(Sukhirin)周五暴力事件的幕后策划者。该事件造成两名领土防卫志愿者死亡、16人受伤。此案暴露该区域安全隐患，引发当地防卫和执法部门高度关注。
desc_original: Authorities are hunting for four suspected leaders of a group blamed for a disturbance in Narathiwat's Sukhirin district on Friday that left two territorial defence volunteers dead and 16 injured.

title: Central Plain provinces on flood watch
desc: The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) has stepped up monitoring of the Chao Phraya River as water levels are expected to rise over the next week, particularly in low-lying areas outside flood barriers in Ayutthaya.
title_cn: 泰国中部平原各府进入防洪警戒
summary_cn: 泰国灾害防止和减灾部门(DDPM)加强了对湄南河(Chao Phraya River)的监测，预计未来一周水位将上升。大城府(Ayutthaya)防洪堤外的低洼地区面临洪涝风险最高，有关部门已启动防灾预案，提醒民众及时准备。
desc_original: The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) has stepped up monitoring of the Chao Phraya River as water levels are expected to rise over the next week, particularly in low-lying areas outside flood barriers in Ayutthaya.

title: Trust builds up content creator market
desc: Thailand's creator market is projected to reach 60 billion baht by 2027 as brands prioritise credibility and sales over follower counts, while tighter regulation and artificial intelligence (AI) reshape competition.
title_cn: 信任驱动泰国内容创作市场增长
summary_cn: 泰国内容创作市场预计到2027年达到600亿泰铢规模。品牌越来越重视创作者可信度和实际销售转化，而非单纯粉丝数量。与此同时，更严格的行业监管和人工智能(AI)技术应用正在深刻重塑市场竞争格局。
desc_original: Thailand's creator market is projected to reach 60 billion baht by 2027 as brands prioritise credibility and sales over follower counts, while tighter regulation and artificial intelligence (AI) reshape competition.

title: Border trade up nearly 23% in July

title_cn: 泰国边境贸易7月增长近23%
summary_cn: 泰国7月边境贸易同比增长近23%，创出令人瞩目的佳绩。但受地区政治紧张局势影响，泰国与柬埔寨间的贸易仍陷入低迷，增长动力受制约，两国经济关系有待改善。
desc_original: Thailand's border trade rose nearly 23% year-on-year in July, but trade with Cambodia remains subdued because of tensions.

title: NT to mull extension  of Thaicom 4 satellite
desc: National Telecom (NT) is expected to evaluate a joint proposal from Thaicom Plc and an Indian state enterprise within this month to extend the operation of the Thaicom 4 satellite by three months, despite concerns about the satellite's engineering and an ongoing deadlock at the regulator.

desc_original: National Telecom (NT) is expected to evaluate a joint proposal from Thaicom Plc and an Indian state enterprise within this month to extend the operation of the Thaicom 4 satellite by three months, despite concerns about the satellite's engineering and an ongoing deadlock at the regulator.

title: GPF keeps  its eye on  the prize
desc: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) is focusing on downside risk, portfolio resilience and transition opportunities as climate change, artificial intelligence (AI) and demographic shifts reshape the investment landscape.

desc_original: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) is focusing on downside risk, portfolio resilience and transition opportunities as climate change, artificial intelligence (AI) and demographic shifts reshape the investment landscape.

desc: Trains running on the Blue Line of Bangkok's fire-damaged Mass Rapid Transit system would resume full services on Monday morning if overnight repairs were complete and guaranteed safe,  Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said on Sunday.

title: Poll finds 67% have little faith in Thai justice system
desc: Poll finds 67% have little faith in Thai justice system Legacy A majority of respondents in a new Suan Dusit Poll expressed low confidence in the fairness and impartiality of Thailand’s justice system following recent political cases. The survey, released today, September 20, was conducted by Suan Dusit Poll at Suan Dusit University among 1,123 respondents nationwide between September 15 and 18. Responses were collected both online and in the field. Asked how much confidence they had in the fairness and neutrality of the Thai justice system in light of recent political cases, 46.39% said they were not very confident, while 21.10% said they had no confidence at all. Taken together, 67.49% expressed little or no confidence. By comparison, 18.52% said they were fairly confident and 7.67% said they had a high level of confidence, while 6.32% were unsure or had no opinion. Photo via Magnific Respondents were also asked whether different groups in Thai society receive equal treatment from the justice system. title: Fire at Tao Poon MRT station disrupts Blue Line services
desc: Fire at Tao Poon MRT station disrupts Blue Line services Legacy Passengers were evacuated from Tao Poon MRT station in Bangkok after an electrical fire broke out on the tracks today, September 20, forcing a temporary service suspension and causing delays. The Rama 9 radio centre received the first report at around 12.20pm after a fire was reported on the rail area near Tao Poon station on Pracharat Sai 2 Road in Bang Sue. Bang Pho firefighters arrived shortly afterwards and found flames around electrical equipment on the tracks. By 12.43pm, crews had entered the station’s electrical control area with thermal imaging equipment and smoke extractors. All passengers had been evacuated, and no injuries were reported. Photo via Fire & Rescue Thailand Bangkok Expressway and Metro Public Company Limited (BEM) said an electrical system fault forced MRT services to be suspended between Bang O and Kamphaeng Phet stations, with passengers advised to use nearby stations. Some stations experienced delays of around 60 minutes. Sparks from the fire also fell to street level, causing minor damage to one parked motorcycle. title: Four jailed for 23 years after 24 Thai women forced into London brothels
desc: Four jailed for 23 years after 24 Thai women forced into London brothels Legacy Four people have been jailed in London over a trafficking network that brought Thai women to Britain and forced them to work in brothels , the Metropolitan Police said. Woolwich Crown Court handed down the sentences on Friday, September 18, totalling nearly 23 years. Detectives identified 24 women they believe were exploited by the group. All arrived last year, mostly on what appeared to be ordinary visitor visas. Police said the women were told they owed tens of thousands of pounds and had their passports taken, leaving many isolated and dependent on their exploiters. They were then taken to brothels in London and Kent and pressed to work off the debts. One woman was smuggled in from the Netherlands, hidden in the back of a vehicle after crossing the Channel. The case began last year when officers carrying out welfare checks at brothels linked to a separate inquiry spoke to Thai women. They said a woman they knew as Freya, or Freya Ice Queen, had taken their passports. That led detectives to a wider group controlling brothels across London and Kent. title_cn: 伦敦妓院贩运案 四人获刑共23年
summary_cn: 英国伦敦沃尔威奇刑事法院9月18日判处四名人贩子共23年监禁。该贩运网络将24名泰国女性骗入英国，以高额债务为由没收护照，强迫她们在伦敦及肯特郡多家妓院卖淫。受害者多持普通访问签证入英，其中一人从荷兰非法运入。警方追查发现该网络控制26家妓院。
desc_original: Four jailed for 23 years after 24 Thai women forced into London brothels Legacy Four people have been jailed in London over a trafficking network that brought Thai women to Britain and forced them to work in brothels , the Metropolitan Police said. Woolwich Crown Court handed down the sentences on Friday, September 18, totalling nearly 23 years. Detectives identified 24 women they believe were exploited by the group. All arrived last year, mostly on what appeared to be ordinary visitor visas. Police said the women were told they owed tens of thousands of pounds and had their passports taken, leaving many isolated and dependent on their exploiters. They were then taken to brothels in London and Kent and pressed to work off the debts. One woman was smuggled in from the Netherlands, hidden in the back of a vehicle after crossing the Channel. The case began last year when officers carrying out welfare checks at brothels linked to a separate inquiry spoke to Thai women. They said a woman they knew as Freya, or Freya Ice Queen, had taken their passports. That led detectives to a wider group controlling brothels across London and Kent. Police linked 26 brothels to the network, two of them

title: Yala attacks leave village official dead and vehicles burned
desc: Yala attacks leave village official dead and vehicles burned Legacy An assistant village headman was shot dead, and several attacks hit Yala overnight, prompting the provincial governor to order an immediate increase in security . The violence occurred across Bannang Sata district from late yesterday, September 19, into the early hours of today. The first incident involved the fatal shooting of 42 year old Hamdi Jesoh, an assistant village headman. Hamdi was riding a motorcycle to visit his wife when unidentified attackers ambushed and shot him with a shotgun , killing him. Photo via DailyNews At around 2.30am, further attacks were reported at several points along Highway 410 in Ban Phong Yamu. Attackers burned tyres, placed a suspicious object on the road, scattered road spikes and destroyed two CCTV cameras. Three construction vehicles belonging to a contractor working on a four-lane road project were also set on fire, including an excavator and road rollers. A resident’s car was also burned while its owner was returning from Betong district. Photo via DailyNews Bannang Sata police, military personnel, administrative officials and forensic officers examined the scene this morning
title_cn: 亚拉地区连环袭击 村官遇害多车被焚
summary_cn: 9月19日傍晚至20日凌晨，泰国南部亚拉班纳沙他区发生连环袭击。42岁的村长助理哈美迪在摩托车上遭枪杀。随后凌晨，武装分子在410号公路沿线放置轮胎、路钉，毁坏监控摄像头，纵火焚烧承包商三台施工车辆包括挖掘机和路滚，还焚烧居民车一辆。省长下令加强安全防范。

title: Woman gives birth beside dinosaur display outside Pattaya mall
desc: Woman gives birth beside dinosaur display outside Pattaya mall Legacy A woman gave birth unexpectedly outside a Pattaya shopping centre, where a newborn girl was found beside a dinosaur display before rescuers located the exhausted mother inside the mall . The Sawang Boriboon rescue foundation was alerted on September 19 to the newborn outside Central Beach Festival on Pattaya Second Road. Rescuers found the baby lying near fencing around a dinosaur display with the umbilical cord still attached . She was initially silent but began crying after responders moved in to help. Photo via Siam Chon News Motorcycle taxi drivers nearby brought cloth to cover the baby and held her while emergency services were contacted. The mother, a 40 year old woman from Bangkok, was initially nowhere to be found. Mall security and rescue workers searched the area before locating her exhausted in a ground-floor toilet. Rescuers said the placenta had been discarded in a bin. Photo via Siam Chon News The woman and her baby were then taken to Pattaya Hospital. Initial examinations found both were safe but required close observation. The mother was suffering from heavy bleeding and severe exhaustion, reporte
title_cn: 芭提雅：女性在购物中心外意外分娩
summary_cn: 9月19日，一名40岁曼谷女性在芭提雅中央海滨节庆购物中心外意外分娩。新生女婴被发现躺在恐龙展示栏杆旁，脐带仍连接。附近摩托出租车司机提供协助。母亲随后在购物中心一楼洗手间被发现，已极度虚弱并大量出血。母婴均被送往芭提雅医院观察，目前安全无虞。

title: Uthai Thani official denies raping minor, claims relationship was consensual
desc: Uthai Thani official denies raping minor, claims relationship was consensual Legacy A local official in Uthai Thani has been charged with raping a girl aged 15 or younger, but denied the allegation and claimed his relationship with the autistic woman had been consensual . The case involves “Ae”, now 20, whose family alleges the official repeatedly raped her from primary school age until she became pregnant at around 15, threatened her family and later raped her again. Her family returned to the police on September 18 with medical evidence and called for the case to be prosecuted. The 65 year old deputy chief of a subdistrict administrative organisation in Lan Sak district appeared at Lan Sak Police Station the same day to meet investigators. Officers checked whether he was carrying any weapons before taking him into an interview room, following allegations from Ae’s family that he had previously claimed to possess guns and had threatened them. Photo via DailyNews Speaking to reporters, the official denied raping Ae but acknowledged having had a relationship with her when she was around 15 to 16 years old. He claimed the relationship was consensual and referred to her as his wife. H
title_cn: 乌泰他尼官员否认强奸指控 辩称系自愿关系
summary_cn: 乌泰他尼兰沙区副区长因强奸未成年少女被控诉。受害人艾现年20岁，自幼遭该65岁官员性侵，在15岁左右怀孕。官员曾威胁其家人且再次性侵。9月18日艾的家人提供医学证据报警。官员到案后否认强奸指控，但承认曾与艾发生关系，声称系自愿且称其为妻子。官员曾扬言持枪，警方在讯问前搜查其是否携带武器。
